description: This file defines various enums, structs, and request/response types related to IPC (Inter-Process Communication) in the OpenClaw project, covering capabilities, canvas operations, notifications, camera controls, and other commands. It serves as a central data model for IPC messages.

classes.name: CanvasPlacement
classes.description: Defines optional position and size hints for the Canvas panel, with coordinates in screen pixels.

classes.name: CanvasShowResult
classes.description: Represents the result of attempting to show a canvas, including status, directory, target URLs, and resolved paths.

methods.name: encode(to:)
methods.description: Custom encoder implementation for serializing the Request enum into JSON.

methods.name: init(from:)
methods.description: Custom decoder implementation for deserializing JSON into the Request enum.
